notes: Single-stage: tokenize a subordinate include, swap only permitted synonyms (case-adjusted, punctuation preserved), inline into a protected frame, and report digests. The protected frame and synonym map must stay byte-identical (immutability check). Small rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth (punctuation/case rules), adversarial_inputs (near-valid tokens, empty body), hidden_case_generalization (fresh paper trees), and quantitative_correctness (exact digests and replacement count). No tool breadth, no dependency chain, no environment pressure; totals bucket to easy.
